items.prompt:
A print article is especially good at emphasizing:
A) data and detail
B) a speaker's tone
C) background music

A video account can especially emphasize:
A) mood and visuals
B) a word's spelling
C) footnotes

A photo emphasizes a:
A) visual moment
B) long statistic
C) footnote

A print article on an election gives vote percentages; a video shows the victory speech and crowd. The video emphasizes:
A) the mood and atmosphere
B) the exact percentages
C) the page count

Why analyze MULTIPLE accounts of the same event?
A) each medium emphasizes different details, giving a fuller picture
B) to pick the shortest
C) to ignore the event
items.answer: A) each medium emphasizes different details, giving a fuller picture

solution.answer: A) each medium emphasizes different details, giving a fuller picture

items.prompt:
A photo of a protest emphasizes what an article cannot:
A) a vivid, immediate visual moment
B) detailed causes
C) long statistics
items.answer: A) a vivid, immediate visual moment

solution.answer: A) a vivid, immediate visual moment

items.prompt:
Three accounts cover a disaster: a report with casualty figures, a photo of a rescued child, and a video of the flooding. Together they:
A) give a fuller account than any one medium alone
B) must all be false
C) are identical
items.answer: A) give a fuller account than any one medium alone

solution.answer: A) give a fuller account than any one medium alone

items.prompt:
When analyzing accounts in different mediums, the KEY question is:
A) which details each account emphasizes and why
B) which is cheapest
C) which is oldest
items.answer: A) which details each account emphasizes and why

solution.answer: A) which details each account emphasizes and why
